stages.headline: Pythagoras noticed that halving a vibrating string gives the same note, higher: the octave.
stages.headlineEnglish: Pythagoras noticed that halving a vibrating string gives the same note, higher: the octave.

stages.headline: Two thirds of the string gives a fifth, three quarters a fourth: harmonious sounds match simple fractions.
stages.headlineEnglish: Two thirds of the string gives a fifth, three quarters a fourth: harmonious sounds match simple fractions.

stages.headline: Note lengths are fractions too: whole, half, quarter, eighth; in a bar they must add up exactly.
stages.headlineEnglish: Note lengths are fractions too: whole, half, quarter, eighth; in a bar they must add up exactly.
